body:
### Summary

Contrary to pip, uv does not install [`eccodeslib`](https://pypi.org/project/eccodeslib/) when requesting [`eccodes`](https://pypi.org/project/eccodes/). A workaround is to request/add `eccodeslib` explicitly. But why is this necessary?


### Platform

Darwin 25.6.0 arm64

### Version

uv 0.11.28 (ebf0f43d7 2026-07-07 aarch64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

Python 3.11.15
title: uv does not install requirement `eccodeslib` when `eccodes` is requested
